payload.name: LeakData
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LeakData checks whether the verified email address on your connected LeakData account appears in known data breaches. Review reported breach sources, dates and affected data types to understand your email exposure.

You can also look up aggregate statistics for a five-character SHA-1 password hash prefix computed on your device. These statistics describe a group of hashes; they cannot tell whether your specific password was leaked. Never share a password or full hash.

An existing LeakData account with API access is required. This plugin supports your account's verified primary email only; domain searches and searches for other people are not supported.

payload.name: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Interactive Brokers account to ChatGPT and manage your portfolio through natural language. 
Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. 
You can also prompt ChatGPT to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. 
ChatGPT never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations.
Member SIPC.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 Interactive Brokers 账户连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然语言管理投资组合。
询问持仓、余额、盈亏、资产配置和未成交订单，或请求实时报价及历史市场数据。
你还可以让 ChatGPT 起草交易指令，例如“以 $200 的限价买入 100 股 AAPL”，这些指令会发送至你的 IBKR 账户，供你审核和批准。
ChatGPT 绝不会直接向市场提交订单。文中展示或讨论的任何交易代码仅用于举例，不代表投资建议。
SIPC 成员。

payload.name: Intuit QuickBooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn your business's raw financial data into clear financial insights. Analyze profitability, cash flow, accounts receivable and payable, and compare your performance against similar businesses in your industry and region. Generate accounting-compliant profit & loss, cash flow statements, balance sheets, and AR/AP aging reports in minutes. Manage invoices, estimates, payments, customers, products, and payroll directly from chat. Upload or paste transactions into the QuickBooks ChatGPT App to analyze personalized results, and view peer loan benchmarks as your business evolves.
payload.longDescription: 将企业原始财务数据转化为清晰的财务见解。分析盈利能力、现金流、应收账款和应付账款，并将经营表现与同一行业和地区的类似企业比较。在几分钟内生成符合会计规范的损益表、现金流量表、资产负债表及应收/应付账款账龄报告。直接在聊天中管理发票、报价单、付款、客户、产品和工资。将交易上传或粘贴到 QuickBooks ChatGPT App，分析个性化结果，并随着企业发展查看同行贷款基准。

payload.name: Stripe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Develop your payments integration faster with the ability to create products, prices, and payment links directly in ChatGPT. Run your business from ChatGPT with the ability to retrieve and manage payments, subscriptions, invoices, refunds, disputes, and customers. Build and debug your payment integration quicker than ever by searching the Stripe documentation and getting integration recommendations without needing to leave ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中创建产品、价格和付款链接，加快支付集成开发。通过获取和管理付款、订阅、发票、退款、争议和客户，在 ChatGPT 中运营业务。无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 Stripe 文档并获取集成建议，更快速地构建和调试支付集成。

payload.name: Xero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check your P&L, cash position, outstanding invoices, top customers and more — directly from ChatGPT. Xero surfaces real-time financial summaries with flexible date ranges, year-over-year comparisons, and links back to Xero for deeper analysis. ChatGPT connects with read-only access. Any data retrieved is used only to respond to your questions and is never stored between sessions.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查看损益、现金头寸、未结发票、主要客户等。Xero 提供实时财务摘要，支持灵活的日期范围、同比比较，以及返回 Xero 进行深入分析的链接。ChatGPT 以只读权限连接。检索的任何数据仅用于回答你的问题，绝不会在会话之间存储。

payload.name: Era Context
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your complete financial picture, ready for real conversations

Connect every bank account, credit card, and investment account to ChatGPT — then ask it anything about your money. Era Context unifies your accounts, categorizes transactions, surfaces recurring charges, and tracks cash flow so ChatGPT can give you answers that are actually grounded in your data.

What you can do:
- See where your money went — Compare spending across months, categories, or accounts. Ask why a month felt expensive, and get a real answer.
- Catch problems before month-end — Project where you'll land on dining, travel, or any category before the damage is done.
- Audit your subscriptions — Surface every recurring charge across all your cards, flag what you're not using, and calculate what canceling the bottom five would save you.
- Get a grounded answer to "can I afford this" — Tell any AI agent what you're considering. It'll check your cash flow, upcoming bills, and buffer — and give you a straight answer.
payload.longDescription:
完整的财务全貌，支持真正有依据的对话

将所有银行账户、信用卡和投资账户连接到 ChatGPT，然后询问任何与你的资金有关的问题。Era Context 汇总账户、分类交易、发现定期扣款并跟踪现金流，让 ChatGPT 能够根据你的真实数据给出答案。

你可以：
- 看钱花在了哪里——比较不同月份、类别或账户的支出。询问为什么某个月花费特别高，并得到有依据的答案。
- 月底前发现问题——在支出失控之前，预测餐饮、旅行或任何类别最终会花费多少。
- 审核订阅——找出所有卡上的每笔定期扣款，标记你未使用的项目，并计算取消使用价值最低的五项能节省多少。
- 对“我负担得起吗”获得有依据的答案——告诉任意 AI 智能体你正在考虑什么。它会检查现金流、即将到期的账单和资金缓冲，并给出直接的回答。

payload.name: Massive
payload.description: 实时股票数据及更多市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Massive brings institutional-grade market data directly into ChatGPT. Query real-time and historical stocks data, options data, futures data, indices data, forex data, and crypto data through Massive.com's financial data API — no code or scraping required.

Stocks & equities: Real-time stock prices, historical stock data, tick-level trades and quotes, OHLC aggregates and candlestick bars, market snapshots, and stock ticker reference data for all US equities and ETFs, sourced from all US exchanges.

Options: Options contracts data including options chains, options prices, quotes, trades, open interest, and historical options data across the full US listed options market.

Futures: Futures market data including futures contracts, futures prices, trades, quotes, and historical futures data across major products.

Indices: Real-time and historical index data including index values and aggregates for major market indices.

Forex & crypto: Currency pairs, exchange rates, crypto prices, and historical FX and cryptocurrency market data.

Beyond prices, pull company fundamentals and financials, corporate actions like dividends and stock splits, market news, technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI), and market status. Ask ChatGPT natural-language questions — "show me NVDA's opening cross" or "chart AAPL's daily bars this quarter" — and get answers backed by licensed, exchange-sourced market data.

Built for traders, quants, analysts, and developers who need accurate stock market data, equities data, and multi-asset market data inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Massive 将机构级市场数据直接带入 ChatGPT。通过 Massive.com 的金融数据 API 查询实时和历史股票、期权、期货、指数、外汇及加密资产数据，无需编写代码或抓取网页。

股票与权益类证券：覆盖全部美国股票和 ETF，提供来自美国所有交易所的实时股价、历史股票数据、逐笔交易与报价、OHLC 汇总和蜡烛图数据、市场快照及股票代码参考数据。

期权：覆盖完整的美国上市期权市场，提供期权合约数据，包括期权链、期权价格、报价、成交、未平仓量及历史期权数据。

期货：提供主要品种的期货市场数据，包括期货合约、价格、成交、报价和历史期货数据。

指数：提供主要市场指数的实时和历史数据，包括指数值及汇总数据。

外汇与加密资产：提供货币对、汇率、加密资产价格，以及历史外汇和加密货币市场数据。

除价格外，还可获取公司基本面和财务数据、股息及股票拆分等公司行动、市场新闻、技术指标（SMA、EMA、MACD、RSI）和市场状态。用自然语言向 ChatGPT 提问，例如“显示 NVDA 的开盘集合竞价”或“绘制 AAPL 本季度的日线图”，即可得到基于获授权的交易所市场数据的答案。

专为需要在 ChatGPT 内获取准确股票市场数据、权益类证券数据和多资产市场数据的交易者、量化人员、分析师及开发者打造。

payload.name: QBO Connector by Meridian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to QuickBooks Online.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple QuickBooks Online companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Create arbitrary QuickBooks transactions, including journal entries
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload and attach receipts and supporting files to QuickBooks transactions
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template
• The craziest use case I tried was "Clone the contents of QBO A into QBO B", and… it worked
payload.longDescription:
此连接器让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 安全地读取和写入 QuickBooks Online。

你可以做的一些事情：
• 将多家 QuickBooks Online 公司连接到同一智能体（非常适合录入公司间会计分录）
• 为每家公司分别选择只读或读写访问权限
• 创建任意 QuickBooks 交易，包括会计分录
• 批量创建发票或导入信用卡交易
• 上传收据和支持文件，并将其附加到 QuickBooks 交易
• 自动填充你公司专用的报告模板
• 我试过最疯狂的用例是“把 QBO A 的内容克隆到 QBO B”，而且……成功了

payload.name: Longbridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research US and HK stocks with market data, fundamentals, analyst ratings, news, filings, screeners, movers, rankings, and short interest. Connect your Longbridge account to analyze balances, positions, profit and loss, cash flow, statements, watchlists, and order history.
payload.longDescription: 利用市场数据、基本面、分析师评级、新闻、披露文件、筛选器、涨跌异动、排行榜和卖空持仓研究美国及香港股票。连接 Longbridge 账户，分析余额、持仓、损益、现金流、对账单、自选列表及订单历史。

payload.name: Alpha Vantage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real-time and historical stock prices, quotes, and price history for any ticker, spanning stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, options, forex, commodities, and global indices. Licensed by major global exchanges for institutional-grade accuracy.

Access 200+ global market indices, ETF profiles and sector allocations, and top gainers/losers/most active tickers. Pull company fundamentals, financial statements, P/E ratio, EPS, market cap, and dividend yield.

Ingest earnings call transcripts, track earnings and IPO calendars, monitor insider transactions and institutional holdings, and review stock splits and dividends. Score news sentiment by ticker, and analyze options chains, put-call ratios, and volume/open-interest ratios for market positioning and sentiment analysis.

Query 50+ technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, and more), plus advanced rolling and fixed-window analytics for volatility, correlation, and performance metrics, ideal for backtesting and building trading strategies.

Check forex and currency exchange rates, global commodity prices (gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agricultural goods), and economic indicators like GDP, CPI, inflation, unemployment, treasury yields, and the federal funds rate.

Built for portfolio analysis, valuation modeling, quantitative research, and agentic workflows, from quick ticker lookups to multi-step financial analysis.
payload.longDescription:
获取任何证券代码的实时和历史股价、行情及价格历史，涵盖股票、ETF、共同基金、期权、外汇、大宗商品和全球指数。获得全球主要交易所许可，提供机构级准确性。

访问 200+ 个全球市场指数、ETF 概况及行业配置，以及涨幅最大、跌幅最大和交易最活跃的证券代码。获取公司基本面、财务报表、市盈率（P/E）、每股收益（EPS）、市值和股息率。

获取财报电话会议文字稿，跟踪财报和 IPO 日历，监控内部人士交易与机构持仓，并查看股票拆分及股息。按证券代码为新闻情绪评分，分析期权链、认沽认购比率及成交量/未平仓量比率，用于市场持仓状况和情绪分析。

查询 50+ 个技术指标（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、布林带、VWAP 等），以及针对波动率、相关性和表现指标的高级滚动窗口与固定窗口分析，适用于回测和构建交易策略。

查看外汇和货币汇率、全球大宗商品价格（金、银、石油、天然气、农产品），以及 GDP、CPI、通胀、失业率、美国国债收益率和联邦基金利率等经济指标。

为投资组合分析、估值建模、量化研究和智能体工作流程而构建，支持从快速证券代码查询到多步骤金融分析的各种场景。

payload.name: Bigdata.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bigdata.com is the AI grounding layer for finance, bringing cited financial research directly into ChatGPT. Research stocks and companies, follow the latest news on your portfolio, and query market data, fundamentals, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, broker and analyst research, sentiment signals, and premium news, with every answer grounded in real, citable sources instead of guesses.

Search billions of documents spanning 25+ years, including 10M+ new public news documents monthly, 200+ premium news sources such as Financial Times, Benzinga, MT Newswires, CNBC and more, filings across 50+ countries, 30+ years of fundamentals, expert interviews, and podcasts. RavenPack's financial knowledge graph resolves company and entity names automatically, so one plain-language question surfaces the right filings, transcripts, news, and data. No manual ticker matching, fabricated numbers, or invented quotes.

Beyond public content, upload and search your own private documents, including notes, internal research, artifacts, and files, alongside public filings and market data, so proprietary research and public sources can be used together in the same query.

Built for anyone making a financial decision, from individual investors researching a stock or tracking their portfolio to analysts at hedge funds, asset managers, and investment banks. Run an initiation report, compare two 10-Ks, prep a pre-earnings or pre-FOMC briefing, track a competitor, catch a sentiment shift before consensus does, or build a sourced brief before a call, all from one grounded search.

Connect in seconds. No setup, no code. You're searching cited financial data from your first prompt.
payload.longDescription:
Bigdata.com 是金融领域的 AI 事实依据层，将带引用的金融研究直接带入 ChatGPT。研究股票与公司、关注投资组合的最新新闻，查询市场数据、基本面、SEC 申报文件、财报电话会议文字稿、券商与分析师研究、情绪信号和优质新闻。每个答案都基于真实、可引用的来源，而非猜测。

搜索跨度达 25+ 年的数十亿份文档，包括每月新增的 超过 1,000 万（10M+）份公开新闻文档，Financial Times、Benzinga、MT Newswires、CNBC 等 200+ 个优质新闻来源，50+ 个国家的申报文件，30+ 年的基本面数据，以及专家访谈与播客。RavenPack 的金融知识图谱会自动识别公司和实体名称，一句日常语言的问题即可找到相关申报文件、文字稿、新闻和数据。无需手工匹配股票代码，不编造数字或引文。

除了公开内容，还能上传和搜索自己的私有文档，包括笔记、内部研究、工作成果与文件，并将其与公开申报文件和市场数据一同检索，在同一次查询中结合专有研究与公开来源。

面向所有需要做财务决策的人，从研究股票或追踪投资组合的个人投资者，到对冲基金、资产管理公司和投资银行的分析师。通过一次有来源依据的搜索，完成首次覆盖报告、比较两份 10-K、准备财报前或 FOMC 前简报、追踪竞争对手、在市场共识形成前发现情绪变化，或在电话会议前撰写附有来源的简报。

数秒即可连接，无需配置或编程。从第一条提示开始，就能搜索带引用的金融数据。

payload.name: Binance
payload.description: 探索 Binance 市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Binance for ChatGPT lets you access and explore Binance public, read-only market data using natural language. Retrieve current and historical prices, order books, recent trades, candlesticks (klines), and exchange metadata across Spot, Futures, and Options. No authentication is required. This app does not access user accounts and does not support trading or transactions.

Market data is provided “as is” from Binance’s public APIs and may be delayed, incomplete, or subject to change. This information is for informational purposes only and should not be relied upon for trading or financial decisions. Binance makes no representations or warranties regarding accuracy or timeliness and disclaims all liability arising from use of this data.
payload.longDescription:
Binance for ChatGPT 让您使用自然语言访问和探索 Binance 公开、只读的市场数据。获取现货、期货和期权的当前及历史价格、订单簿、近期成交、蜡烛图（K 线）及交易所元数据。无需身份验证。此应用不会访问用户账户，也不支持交易或转账等交易操作。

市场数据来自 Binance 公开 API，按“现状”提供，可能存在延迟、不完整或发生变化。这些信息仅供参考，不应作为交易或财务决策的依据。Binance 不对准确性或及时性作出任何声明或保证，并免除因使用这些数据而产生的一切责任。

payload.name: CoinGecko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View top cryptocurrency prices live, crypto charts, market cap, and trading volume. Discover today’s trending coins, top crypto gainers and losers in the market such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Hyperliquid, and more. You can also compare them side by side in a table.
payload.longDescription: 查看主要加密货币的实时价格、加密货币图表、市值及交易量。发现今日热门币种，以及 Bitcoin、Ethereum、Solana、BNB、Hyperliquid 等市场中涨幅和跌幅领先的加密货币。还可以在表格中并排比较。

payload.name: Webull
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore global market data and portfolio insights through AI-powered conversations. Webull MCP provides convenient, read-only access to market information, account balances, positions, and investment insights, helping users interact with financial information in a more intuitive and accessible way.
payload.longDescription: 通过 AI 对话探索全球市场数据和投资组合洞察。Webull MCP 提供便捷的只读访问，涵盖市场信息、账号余额、证券持仓和投资洞察，帮助用户以更直观、易用的方式了解金融信息。

payload.name: Parqet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ChatGPT to understand your Parqet portfolios: current holdings, value, performance, dividends, and transaction history based on your own data.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT，依据自己的数据了解 Parqet 投资组合：当前持仓、价值、表现、股息及交易历史。

payload.name: Financial Datasets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Financial Datasets gives ChatGPT access to structured stock market data for 27,000+ active and delisted U.S. tickers. Research companies and markets with real-time and historical prices, primary-source SEC filings, financial statements and metrics, earnings, operating KPIs, news, insider and institutional ownership, index fund holdings, interest rates, and stock screening.
payload.longDescription: Financial Datasets 让 ChatGPT 访问 27,000+ 个在交易及已退市美国股票代码的结构化市场数据。利用实时和历史价格、一手 SEC 申报文件、财务报表和指标、财报、经营关键绩效指标（KPI）、新闻、内部人士及机构持股、指数基金持仓、利率和股票筛选开展企业与市场研究。

payload.name: Ramp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Ramp account to ChatGPT and manage finances through natural conversation.

For Finance Teams: Analyze spend trends, identify top expenses, spot anomalies, and run queries on transactions, vendors, and budgets—all in real time without leaving ChatGPT.

For Employees: Check card balances, activate cards, add transaction memos, request reimbursements, get policy answers, and manage travel expenses instantly.

Access is permission-based: employees see only their data, while admins get full analytics and team oversight.
payload.longDescription:
将 Ramp 账户连接至 ChatGPT，通过自然对话管理财务。

财务团队：实时分析支出趋势、识别主要支出、发现异常，并查询交易、供应商及预算，无需离开 ChatGPT。

员工：即时查看卡片余额、激活卡片、添加交易备注、申请报销、获取政策解答，并管理差旅费用。

访问基于权限：员工仅能查看自己的数据，管理员可获得完整分析和团队监督功能。

payload.name: Intuit Credit Karma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Credit Karma brings together credit insights, spending analysis, and personalized offers in one place. Understand the factors affecting your credit score, track your spending by category over time, and connect your accounts for budgeting insights. Compare personalized credit card and personal loan options with clear, conversational guidance to make confident financial decisions.
payload.longDescription: Credit Karma 将信用洞察、支出分析及个性化方案集中在一处。了解影响信用评分的因素、按类别跟踪不同时期的支出，并连接账户获取预算洞察。借助清晰的对话式指导，比较个性化信用卡及个人贷款选项，自信作出财务决策。

payload.name: Stocktwits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stocktwits connects AI assistants to one of the world’s largest communities of traders and investors.

Search stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures, and other markets using natural language to access real-time market conversations, retail sentiment, trending symbols, Watcher activity, and community insights. 

Whether you’re researching an earnings reaction, monitoring sentiment around a ticker, tracking breaking news, or discovering emerging market themes and trade ideas, Stocktwits provides context behind market moves, not just price updates.
payload.longDescription:
Stocktwits 将 AI 助手连接到全球规模最大的交易者和投资者社区之一。

用自然语言搜索股票、ETF、加密货币、期货及其他市场，获取实时市场讨论、散户情绪、热门代码、关注者活动和社区洞察。

无论是研究市场对财报的反应、监测某个股票代码的情绪、追踪突发新闻，还是发现新兴市场主题和交易思路，Stocktwits 都提供市场变动背后的背景，而不仅仅是价格更新。

payload.name: CoinMarketCap
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

payload.name: Next Stock - Market Insights
payload.description: 自主开展数据驱动的股票分析

Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.

payload.name: Bybit
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange. This plugin provides real-time public market data directly in your ChatGPT conversations — no account or API key required.

Capabilities:
• Real-time prices: Get the latest price, 24h change, and trading volume for any spot or futures pair on Bybit.
• K-line charts: Retrieve candlestick (OHLCV) data across multiple timeframes (1m to 1M), rendered as an interactive chart widget.
• Order book depth: View live bid/ask spread and market depth for any symbol.
• Contract specs: Look up minimum order quantity, tick size, and maximum leverage for any instrument.
• Funding rate: Check the current funding rate for USDT perpetual futures.

All data is sourced from Bybit's public REST API (v5). Provided for informational purposes only. Does not constitute investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation to engage in any transaction.
payload.longDescription:
Bybit 是全球领先的加密货币交易所。本插件直接在你的 ChatGPT 对话中提供实时公开市场数据，无需账户或 API 密钥。

功能：
• 实时价格：获取 Bybit 任意现货或期货交易对的最新价格、24h 涨跌幅和交易量。
• K 线图：获取多个时间周期（1m 至 1M）的蜡烛图（OHLCV）数据，并呈现为交互式图表组件。
• 订单簿深度：查看任意交易代码的实时买卖价差和市场深度。
• 合约规格：查询任意交易品种的最小下单数量、最小价格变动单位和最大杠杆。
• 资金费率：查询 USDT 永续期货的当前资金费率。

所有数据来自 Bybit 公开 REST API（v5）。仅供信息参考，不构成投资建议、要约或进行任何交易的招揽。

payload.name: IOL invertironline

Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI). Review your portfolio holdings, cash balance across settlement terms, and recent account activity. payload.longDescription: 将您的富果 Fugle 投资平台与 ChatGPT 无缝整合，打造个性化的智能投资助手。通过自然语言对话，您可以管理关注股票、投资笔记、股价到价通知，并获取专业市场分析和研究报告内容。本工具不提供任何投资建议，所有信息仅供参考。

payload.name: LONA Trading Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LONA Trading Assistant helps you develop, backtest, and optimize algorithmic trading strategies using AI. Upload market data from supported exchanges, write Python-based trading strategies, and run comprehensive backtests to see how your strategies would have performed historically. View detailed performance reports with interactive charts showing entry/exit points, returns, and risk metrics.
payload.longDescription: LONA Trading Assistant 帮助您利用 AI 开发、回测和优化算法交易策略。上传来自受支持交易所的市场数据，编写基于 Python 的交易策略，并运行全面回测，查看策略在历史上可能的表现。查看详细表现报告及交互图表，展示入场和出场点、收益及风险指标。

payload.name: StrategyTune
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
StrategyTune 是交易策略回测平台，此插件让 ChatGPT 能够直接操作它。

ChatGPT 可以编写并保存构建策略所需的组件，包括图表指标、可复用的市场条件（StrategyTune 称之为信号和过滤器）以及完整交易策略，再在 StrategyTune 的沙盒云环境中，使用真实历史市场数据逐笔运行。简单策略可在数秒内回测一年的历史数据，便于快速迭代。

它不局限于自动策略回测。ChatGPT 还能在同一沙盒中运行自定义研究代码：统计某条件发生的频率、测量特定时刻的数值、收集自己的统计数据，并在运行中记录日志。你说明想检查什么，ChatGPT 编写代码、运行、读取输出，再告诉你发现了什么。

运行结束后，你会获得完整报告，包括绩效统计及其背后的逐笔交易。ChatGPT 还能操作已打开的 StrategyTune 图表：读取 K 线和各指标的计算值，添加并配置指标，在时间轴上标注条件，直观看到条件何时成立，并切换品种或时间周期。读取计算值也有助于它调试自己的工作：若它编写的指标在图表上看起来不对，就能检查曲线背后的实际数字，而非猜测。

一切都基于历史数据运行。此插件不会连接券商、提交实盘订单或提供投资建议。

payload.name: S&P Global - Deterministic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use natural language to query a range of S&P Global datasets, including S&P Capital IQ Financials, transcripts, and more. Designed to save time and resources for engineering, product, and business teams in financial services, this server streamlines access to company information, financial statements, historical market data, and global securities.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言查询一系列 S&P Global 数据集，包括 S&P Capital IQ Financials、文字稿等。此服务器旨在为金融服务行业的工程、产品和业务团队节省时间与资源，简化公司信息、财务报表、历史市场数据和全球证券的访问。

payload.name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks. With MCP, firms can integrate new solutions efficiently, drive innovation, and maximize the value of their financial operations—ensuring consistent, context-rich decision-making throughout the investment process.
payload.longDescription: FactSet 模型上下文协议（MCP）是一项开放、基于 API 的标准，旨在顺畅连接不同平台上的金融数据、分析模型和应用。MCP 通过实现顺畅互操作，让投资团队无论采用何种工具或技术栈，都能轻松分享洞察、简化工作流程并加强协作。借助 MCP，公司可高效整合新方案、推动创新，并充分发挥金融业务的价值，确保整个投资流程中的决策一致且拥有丰富的上下文。

payload.name: Mercury
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Mercury account to ChatGPT to get answers about your finances in the same place you’re already doing the rest of your work.
payload.longDescription: 将 Mercury 账户连接到 ChatGPT，在您已经处理其他工作的同一个地方，获得有关财务状况的答案。

payload.name: Remitly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.

Remitly is trusted by millions of customers who rely on it to send money home, donate or have local currency while traveling abroad. Our customers and their recipients are located in over 170 countries across the globe, and Remitly offers 24/7 customer support.

You can try asking:
- What's the best rate for sending 50 usd to India from USA
- What delivery methods are supported sending USA to Mexico?
- Where can I pickup cash near Monterrey, Mexico?
- What's the fastest way to send $399 from USA to Mexico?
payload.longDescription:
你可以在 ChatGPT 内使用 Remitly，在汇款前规划资金转账，询问到账时间、费用、汇率等问题。

数百万客户信赖 Remitly，用它向家乡汇款、捐款，或在境外旅行时获得当地货币。我们的客户及收款人遍布全球超过 170 个国家，Remitly 提供 24/7 客户支持。

你可以试着问：
- 从 USA 向印度汇 50 usd，最优惠的汇率是多少？
- 从 USA 向墨西哥汇款支持哪些收款方式？
- 在墨西哥蒙特雷附近哪里可以领取现金？
- 从 USA 向墨西哥汇 $399，最快的方式是什么？

payload.name: Rallies
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.

Connect your brokerage to ask questions about your own portfolio; what drove today's move, where your risk concentrates, how a holding compares to its peers — without juggling six tabs or spreadsheets.

What you can do:

Chat with any ticker or your full portfolio
Work from live charts with indicators (RSI, MACD, 20/50 MA)
Analyze earnings history, estimates, and surprises
Screen by price action, fundamentals, or technical setups
Review options flow, darkpool prints, short interest, insider and politician trades
Track your net worth and holdings across connected accounts
Follow AI Arena, where frontier models run live portfolios in public with transparent reasoning

Rallies is a research tool and does not execute trades.
payload.longDescription:
Rallies 是一款股票市场 AI 研究应用，基于实时数据而非过时的网络结果构建。用日常英语询问任意美国股票代码，获得基于实时价格、基本面、财报、SEC 申报文件、期权资金流、技术面、分析师行动、内部人士活动和对冲基金持仓的答案。

连接券商后，可就自己的投资组合提问：今天的波动由什么驱动、风险集中在哪里、某项持仓与同类公司相比如何，无需在六个标签页或电子表格之间切换。

你可以：

就任意股票或整个投资组合对话
使用带指标的实时图表（RSI、MACD、20/50 MA）
分析历史财报、预期与超预期情况
按价格走势、基本面或技术形态筛选
查看期权资金流、暗池成交、空头仓位、内部人士与政客交易
追踪已连接账户的净资产和持仓
关注 AI Arena，前沿模型在这里公开运行实盘投资组合，并透明展示推理过程

Rallies 是研究工具，不执行交易。

payload.name: Intuit TurboTax
payload.description: 税额估算、报税准备及专家服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get fast federal tax estimates and discover filing and preparation options with Intuit TurboTax-powered tools. Use a simple tax estimator or a guided interview to collect what matters, and watch your refund or amount owed update as you go. Get a clear view of the forms and documents you need, what you have, and what is left to gather—then upload securely when you sign in and complete consent when prompted for protected features. Ready for a human? Find trusted tax pros, check real availability, and book an appointment. Confident tax filing starts here.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Intuit TurboTax 支持的工具，快速估算联邦税额，了解申报和报税准备选项。通过简单税额估算器或引导式问答收集重要信息，并在操作过程中查看退税额或应缴税额实时更新。清楚了解所需表格和文件、已经准备好的材料，以及仍需收集的材料——登录后安全上传，并在使用受保护功能收到提示时完成同意授权。需要人工帮助？查找可信赖的税务专业人士，查看实际可预约时间，并预约会面。从这里开始，有把握地报税。

payload.name: Fiscal.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fiscal.ai helps users research public companies through source-linked financial statements, ratios, prices, filings, news, ownership, segments, KPIs, earnings events, and fund letters available under their Fiscal.ai account.
payload.longDescription: Fiscal.ai 帮助用户利用其 Fiscal.ai 账户可访问的、关联来源的财务报表、比率、价格、申报文件、新闻、所有权、业务分部、KPI、财报事件和基金投资者信来研究上市公司。

payload.name: Simply Family Budget
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Simply Family Budget helps households understand what they can actually afford by bringing balances, transactions, budgets, recurring entries, cashflow, and projected balances together. Review and manage your family’s financial records, wallets, categories, and tags directly through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Simply Family Budget 将余额、交易、预算、周期性记录、现金流和预计余额整合起来，帮助家庭了解实际能负担哪些支出。直接通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理家庭财务记录、钱包、分类和标签。

payload.name: LSEG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The LSEG connector provides real-time access to LSEG's comprehensive financial market data ecosystem, spanning across asset classes and domains. It enables seamless integration of institutional-grade market data, analytics and valuation tools directly into conversational AI workflows, allowing users to access deep market insights, perform complex calculations and analyse financial instruments through natural language interactions.
payload.longDescription: LSEG 连接器提供对 LSEG 全面金融市场数据生态的实时访问，覆盖多种资产类别和领域。它将机构级市场数据、分析及估值工具顺畅整合到对话式 AI 工作流中，让用户通过自然语言交互获取深入市场洞察、执行复杂计算，并分析金融工具。

payload.name: Pocket Ledger Expense Tracker
payload.description: 通过聊天跟踪费用和预算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PocketLedger is a personal finance app, expense tracker, spending tracker, and budget tracker inside ChatGPT. Log expenses by chatting, track spending, search your transaction history, spot possible duplicate charges, and get clear spending reports, category reports, financial reports, and monthly budget summaries. It helps with expense management, money management, budget management, and everyday personal finance without spreadsheets or a separate finance app.
payload.longDescription: PocketLedger 是 ChatGPT 内的个人财务应用，可跟踪费用、支出和预算。通过聊天记录费用、跟踪支出、搜索交易历史、发现可能的重复扣款，并获取清晰的支出报告、分类报告、财务报告和月度预算摘要。它帮助您管理费用、资金、预算及日常个人财务，无需电子表格或单独的财务应用。

payload.name: OptionsCalc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OptionsCalc helps you build and visualize options strategies with full Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega), implied volatility, and interactive P/L heatmaps. Describe a trade idea, like 'show me an iron condor on AAPL', and get instant payoff diagrams, risk metrics, and scenario analysis across price and time. Supports multi-leg strategies including spreads, condors, straddles, and butterflies.
payload.longDescription: OptionsCalc 帮助你构建和可视化期权策略，提供完整的希腊字母指标（delta、gamma、theta、vega）、隐含波动率及交互式盈亏热图。描述交易想法，例如“展示 AAPL 的铁鹰策略”，即可即时获得收益图、风险指标，以及随价格和时间变化的情景分析。支持多腿策略，包括价差、鹰式、跨式及蝶式策略。

payload.name: InvestmentIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Set a savings goal and instantly discover how much to invest monthly, how long it will take, or what return rate you need to get there — all in one smart calculator. Choose from Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive strategies and watch an interactive chart project your wealth up to 50 years into the future. See a clear breakdown of your starting balance, total contributions, and interest earned at a glance. This app is suitable for all ages.
payload.longDescription: 设置储蓄目标，立即了解每月需要投资多少、需要多长时间，或需要什么回报率才能达成目标——全部在一个智能计算器中完成。选择保守、适中或积极策略，通过交互式图表预测未来最长 50 年的财富。清晰分解初始余额、累计投入及赚取的利息，一目了然。此应用适合所有年龄段。

payload.name: Aiera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access institutional-grade financial data from Aiera, including live corporate events, filings, company publications, broker research, and much more.
payload.longDescription: 访问 Aiera 的机构级金融数据，包括实时公司活动、申报文件、公司出版物、券商研究等丰富内容。

payload.name: StockLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about a stock and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. The 600 largest companies answer with no StockLens account and no sign-in. Free accounts read those same 600, Pro reads the top 5,000, and Max reads the whole scored universe. Any account also reads every stock on its own watchlist, however deep it ranks.

Find your next idea instead of checking one ticker at a time. Discover Stocks screens the whole nightly-analyzed universe by region, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, or volume and ranks the results by any StockLens score, so "the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ" is a single question. Free accounts browse with scores hidden; Pro and Max plans include the ranked results.

Build and manage your own watchlist right from the conversation: add or remove a ticker, then ask how everything on it scored last night. Free tracks up to 10 stocks; Pro and Max plans track an unlimited number.

When one stock matters, start a full analysis on demand, follow its progress, and read the result. Plus Analysis adds an AI narrative and is part of the Pro and Max plans.

Try:
- "How does NVDA score on StockLens?"
- "Show me the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ from last night's run"
- "Run a StockLens analysis on GOOGL"
- "Add GOOGL to my StockLens watchlist"
- "How do the stocks on my StockLens watchlist score?"

Analyses, discovery, and your watchlist connect to your StockLens account over OAuth. Plan changes are made by signing in at stocklens.com. For informational and educational purposes only, not investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
StockLens 每晚从五个维度为 9,500+ 只股票评分：基本面、技术面、风险、情绪和宏观。询问某只股票，即可获得最新综合评分、各维度评分，以及本次评分发现的优势和挑战。查询规模最大的 600 家公司无需 StockLens 账户，也无需登录。免费账户可以查看这 600 家公司，Pro 可查看排名前 5,000 家，Max 可查看所有已评分股票。任何账户都能查看自己自选股列表中的每只股票，无论其排名多靠后。

无需逐个检查股票代码，即可寻找下一个投资思路。Discover Stocks 可按地区、交易所、板块、行业、市值或成交量筛选每晚分析的全部股票，并按任意 StockLens 评分排序，因此只需一句“NASDAQ 上评分最高的五只科技股”。免费账户浏览时不显示评分；Pro 和 Max 套餐包含排序结果。

直接在对话中建立和管理自己的自选股列表：添加或移除股票代码，然后询问列表中所有股票昨晚的评分。免费版最多跟踪 10 只股票；Pro 和 Max 套餐不限数量。

当你关注某只股票时，可以按需启动完整分析，跟踪进度并阅读结果。Plus Analysis 增加 AI 文字分析，包含在 Pro 和 Max 套餐中。

试着问：
- “NVDA 在 StockLens 上的评分如何？”
- “给我看看昨晚 NASDAQ 上评分最高的五只科技股”
- “对 GOOGL 运行 StockLens 分析”
- “将 GOOGL 添加到我的 StockLens 自选股列表”
- “我的 StockLens 自选股列表中的股票评分如何？”

分析、股票发现和自选股列表通过 OAuth 连接到你的 StockLens 账户。套餐变更需登录 stocklens.com。仅供信息参考和教育用途，不构成投资建议。

payload.name: Gainium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gainium helps users inspect their trading bot workspace from ChatGPT through a read-only connector. Users can list and review bots, deals, account balances, connected exchanges, strategy schemas, market screener data, curated presets, and existing backtest request information without creating bots, starting deals, placing trades, or changing account state.
payload.longDescription: Gainium 通过只读连接器帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中查看交易机器人工作区。用户可以列出和查看机器人、交易、账户余额、已连接交易所、策略结构、市场筛选器数据、精选预设及现有回测请求信息，无需创建机器人、启动交易、下单或更改账户状态。

payload.name: Experian Credit Cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Credit Cards, Experian’s marketplace for credit cards, lets users explore credit card options for various types of user needs directly inside ChatGPT with minimal input. By answering 1 question (type of card user is interested in) users receive relevant credit card offers from Experian’s lending partners. The options are not final, but starting points for comparison. Users can seamlessly continue to Experian to view personalized matches and then proceed to the lender to apply. No personally identifiable information is collected in the ChatGPT experience, and users can skip entering type of card if desired, as these are simply used to help users identify cards that match their credit profile.
payload.longDescription: Experian Credit Cards 是 Experian 的信用卡市场，让用户只需提供极少信息，便可直接在 ChatGPT 中探索满足各种需求的信用卡选项。回答 1 个问题（感兴趣的卡片类型），即可获得 Experian 贷款合作伙伴的相关信用卡优惠。这些选项并非最终方案，而是用于比较的起点。用户可以顺畅转到 Experian 查看个性化匹配，然后进入贷款机构申请。在 ChatGPT 体验中不收集可识别个人身份的信息；用户也可选择跳过填写卡片类型，这些信息仅用于帮助找到符合其信用状况的卡片。

payload.name: Zacks Financial Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Zacks Investment Research’s trusted data right in your AI chat — and give your AI assistant an edge. Zacks Connect AI is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that plugs the Zacks Rank, estimates, fundamentals, Zacks Investment Research and market news straight into your Claude chat.
Financial reported data, Zacks Ranks, Data history, daily prices, Analyst consensus , reasons to buy, investment ideas.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 AI 聊天中使用 Zacks Investment Research 的可信数据，让你的 AI 助手更具优势。Zacks Connect AI 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，将 Zacks Rank、预测数据、基本面、Zacks Investment Research 和市场新闻直接接入你的 Claude 聊天。
财务报告数据、Zacks Ranks、历史数据、每日价格、分析师共识、买入理由和投资思路。

payload.name: WealthCheck Financial Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a complete snapshot of your financial health in seconds. WealthCheck analyzes your income, expenses, savings, and debt to calculate your net worth, savings rate, and monthly spending — then gives you a personalized action plan to improve. Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.
payload.longDescription: 几秒内获得完整的财务健康快照。WealthCheck 分析你的收入、支出、储蓄和债务，计算净资产、储蓄率和每月支出，然后提供个性化行动计划，帮助改善财务状况。无论是第一次编制预算，还是优化现有计划，都能清楚看到资金去向及下一步该做什么。

payload.name: Fold
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fold helps users securely review their own transactions, accounts, investments, recurring expenses, credit profile, and savings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Fold 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 安全地查看自己的交易、账户、投资、周期性费用、信用状况和储蓄。

payload.name: Brex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brex helps finance teams and employees review company spend through ChatGPT. Users can look up expenses, cards, limits, users, bills, vendors, and accounting records; analyze spend; attach receipts from HTTPS URLs; update memos and attendees; assign card expenses to limits; export expense data; and submit product feedback.

payload.name: Insurify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

payload.longDescription: 无需再手工填写发票表格。此应用利用智能默认值创建发票：识别客户、记住定价，并根据此前发票自动填充细节。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你的需求，剩下的交给它。在一处查看、更新和管理所有发票。

payload.name: Crunchbase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.

Crunchbase MCP brings private market data and predictive signals into the AI tools and agents you already use. Built for investors, go-to-market teams, product builders, and anyone else who needs answers, not just search results.

Ask in plain English. No code, no technical training. The MCP figures out the filters, fields, and connections you might not have known to ask for, and returns a complete, sourced answer. Most other MCP servers only offer raw search and list data.

Supercharge your workflow. Identify high-growth companies, run diligence in seconds, and act on opportunities before other firms catch on, or give your customers foresight into market movements directly in your product, without the engineering lift.

Build lists you can return to. Save companies as you find them. A search today becomes a pipeline you monitor over time.

Predictions you can act on. Forecasts of what a company is likely to do next such as: funding, acquisition, IPO, growth, shutdown, or headcount cuts, plus an estimated current valuation. Every prediction carries a confidence tier, so you can rank an entire market by likelihood instead of reading profiles one at a time. Powered by 15M+ predictions refreshed weekly.

Why Crunchbase? The only dataset combining the aggregated activity of 80M users, 1,000+ public sources, and 600k+ data team members, VC partners, and subject-matter experts.
payload.longDescription:
在对话中直接获取可信的私募市场情报。

提升工作效率。识别高增长企业，几秒内完成尽职调查，在其他公司发现之前抓住机会；或者直接在您的产品中向客户提供市场走势前瞻，无需投入繁重的工程开发。

建立可反复查看的列表。发现企业时即可保存。今天的搜索结果可以成为您持续监测的项目管线。

获得可据以行动的预测。预测企业下一步可能的动向，例如融资、收购、IPO、增长、停业或裁员，并提供当前估值的估计。每项预测均标注置信度等级，让您能够按发生概率对整个市场排序，而不是逐一阅读企业资料。由每周更新的 15M+ 项预测提供支持。

payload.longDescription:
让 ChatGPT 成为你的私募市场研究智能体。发现公司、构建市场图谱、起草投资备忘录和监测竞争对手——全部由 CB Insights 的预测情报支持。利用超过 11M 份经过双重验证的公司档案、对近期股权交易的领先覆盖、专有分类体系、独特评分、隐蔽信号以及超过 20 年的前沿技术研究，抢在竞争对手之前识别和分析相关且潜力巨大的公司。

专为寻找收购目标的企业战略人员、筛选投资项目的风投机构，以及寻觅新合作伙伴的业务拓展团队打造。如果你的工作涉及非上市公司，CB Insights 提供所需洞察，让你抢先采取下一步行动。

payload.name: Portfolio Dividend Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Portfolio Dividend Tracker helps users review portfolio holdings and performance, inspect market and cash-flow data, and manage transactions, dividends, expenses, bookings, cash corrections, and investment strategies through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Portfolio Dividend Tracker 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看投资组合持仓和表现、检查市场与现金流数据，以及管理交易、股息、费用、记账、现金修正和投资策略。

payload.name: Daloopa
payload.description: 附来源链接的财务关键指标
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Daloopa supplies high quality fundamental data sourced from filings, investor presentations, earnings transcripts and company presentations, with hyperlinks to source document overlaying each data point. Provides a zero-hallucination foundation for any quantitative financial analysis in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Daloopa 提供来自申报文件、投资者演示文稿、业绩会议转录和公司演示文稿的高质量基本面数据，每个数据点均附有原始文档的超链接。为 ChatGPT 中的任何定量财务分析提供无幻觉的数据基础。

payload.name: MSCI Connector
payload.description: 查询 MSCI 投资数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MSCI Connector lets authorized users query entitlement-controlled MSCI index, private capital, portfolio, and real-assets data in natural language, including performance, benchmarks, holdings, exposures, constituents, and methodology insights.
payload.longDescription: MSCI Connector 让获授权用户以自然语言查询受访问权益控制的 MSCI 指数、私募资本、投资组合及实物资产数据，包括表现、基准、持仓、风险敞口、成分及方法论洞察。

payload.name: Rabbu
payload.description: 查找待售 Airbnb 房产等信息
payload.summaryOriginal: Find Airbnbs for sale and more
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rabbu helps short-term rental investors find Airbnb properties for sale, analyze real market performance, and make smarter buy decisions. Explore listings, compare markets, estimate revenue, and connect with experienced agents and lenders—all in one place. Designed for clarity and data-driven investing, not hype.
payload.longDescription: Rabbu 帮助短租投资者寻找待售 Airbnb 房产、分析真实市场表现，并做出更明智的购买决策。在同一个地方浏览房源、比较市场、估算收入，并联系经验丰富的经纪人和贷款机构。旨在提供清晰信息并支持数据驱动的投资，而非炒作。

payload.name: Finhay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Vietnam's financial markets through Finhay Securities' infrastructure. Get stock prices across HOSE, HNX, and UPCOM, dive into company financials: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow..., and track macroeconomic indicators, FX rates, gold, and commodity prices. Monitor your portfolio performance, review order history, and analyze holdings by sector or asset class. Built for investors who want to research, analyze, and act on Vietnam's market. All through conversation.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Finhay Securities 的基础设施访问越南金融市场。获取 HOSE、HNX 和 UPCOM 的股价，深入查看企业财务数据：利润表、资产负债表、现金流等，并跟踪宏观经济指标、汇率、黄金及大宗商品价格。监测投资组合表现，查看订单历史，并按行业或资产类别分析持仓。面向希望研究、分析并参与越南市场的投资者。全部通过对话完成。

payload.name: TraderSpy
payload.description: 加密货币信号和鲸鱼数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.

Ask what the AI signal engine has published for a coin and you get the entry, the take-profit ladder, the stop and what actually happened to earlier signals — not just a direction. Ask what the whales are doing and you get real positions held by top-performing traders on Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, plus a leaderboard scored on PnL, win rate, ROI and consistency. Prices, candles and 13 technical indicators are one question away, and with your own account connected you can ask how far a position sits from liquidation.

Every tool is read-only. TraderSpy cannot place, close or modify an order and has no withdrawal or transfer tool — it answers questions, you place your own trades. A free account is enough to start.
payload.longDescription:
TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，让你直接询问市场情况，无需在不同交易所标签页间切换。

询问 AI 信号引擎对某个币种发布了什么，即可获得入场价、分级止盈价、止损价，以及此前信号的实际结果，而不仅仅是交易方向。询问鲸鱼在做什么，即可获得 Binance、Hyperliquid、Bybit 和 OKX 上表现优异交易者的真实持仓，以及根据盈亏、胜率、ROI 和稳定性评分的排行榜。只需一句提问，就能获取价格、K 线和 13 个技术指标；连接自己的账户后，还能询问持仓距离强制平仓有多远。

每个工具都是只读的。TraderSpy 无法下单、平仓或修改订单，也没有提现或转账工具——它回答问题，交易由你自己执行。免费账户即可开始使用。

payload.name: AIXBT
payload.description: 加密货币情报与市场叙事
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research crypto intel and narratives.
payload.longDescription: 研究加密货币情报与市场叙事。

payload.name: Double
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Double manages the month-end close. It replaces spreadsheets and scattered checklists with a single system connected to your GL or ERP: tasks, team assignments, and close status all in one place.

Connect it to ChatGPT and you can act on your close without switching apps. Create and reassign tasks, turn meeting notes into action items, and draft status updates for your team or clients, with changes writing back to Double in real time. You control what ChatGPT can read or update in your account.

Works with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, and finance teams running the month-end close.
payload.longDescription:
Double 管理月末结账。它以连接总账（GL）或 ERP 的统一系统取代电子表格和分散的检查清单，将任务、团队分工和结账状态汇总到一处。

连接到 ChatGPT 后，无需切换应用即可处理结账工作。创建和重新分配任务，将会议笔记转为行动事项，并为团队或客户起草状态更新；更改会实时写回 Double。你可以控制 ChatGPT 能读取或更新账户中的哪些内容。

支持 QuickBooks、Xero、NetSuite 和 Sage Intacct。专为执行月末结账的记账人员、会计师及财务团队打造。

payload.name: Dakota Marketplace
payload.description: 搜索资产配置机构和基金
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dakota Marketplace helps users research allocator organizations, contacts, marketplace searches, fundraising news, private-market strategies, transactions, funds, and performance benchmarks through read-only searches.
payload.longDescription: Dakota Marketplace 帮助用户通过只读搜索，研究资产配置机构、联系人、市场搜索、募资新闻、私募市场策略、交易、基金和业绩基准。

payload.name: XE Currency Converter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: XE Currency Converter handles any request to convert money between currencies, check a live exchange rate, or compare currency values. Use it for prompts like 'convert 100 USD to EUR', 'how much is 50 usd in inr', "what's the GBP to JPY rate right now", or '250 dollars in rupees' — with or without an explicit amount, and with currency codes in any case or written as names. Returns the converted amount and the current mid-market exchange rate.
payload.longDescription: XE Currency Converter 处理货币之间的金额换算、实时汇率查询或币值比较请求。可用于“将 100 USD 换算为 EUR”、“50 usd 等于多少 inr”、“现在 GBP 对 JPY 的汇率是多少”或“250 美元折合多少卢比”等提示——无论是否明确给出金额，货币代码使用任何大小写，或用货币名称书写，都可以处理。返回换算金额和当前市场中间汇率。

payload.name: Liberty Mutual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get a Liberty Mutual Insurance quote estimate with Liberty Mutual-powered tools. Enter a few details to receive customized auto quote estimates. When you’re ready to buy, you will be redirected to Liberty Mutual’s secure website to complete the application, payment, and policy issuance. After purchase, Liberty Mutual provides full customer service, claims support, and policy management. 

Liberty Mutual is a leading national property & casualty insurer offering dependable auto insurance backed by decades of financial strength and customer service. With Liberty Mutual through ChatGPT you can get a fast, personalized auto insurance quote estimate by providing only a few simple details. 

No purchase is required to get estimates. By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the personal information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Liberty Mutual, affiliates and service providers for the purpose of providing you with an auto insurance quote estimate. Please only share the personal information requested to the questions Liberty Mutual asks for providing you with a quote estimate. Please don’t provide any additional sensitive personal information. To learn more about how Liberty Mutual processes your personal information, please see our privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Liberty Mutual 提供支持的工具，获取 Liberty Mutual Insurance 的报价估算。输入少量信息，即可获得个性化汽车保险报价估算。准备购买时，您将跳转到 Liberty Mutual 的安全网站，完成申请、付款和保单签发。购买后，Liberty Mutual 提供完整的客户服务、理赔支持和保单管理。

Liberty Mutual 是美国领先的财产与意外伤害保险公司，凭借数十年的财务实力和客户服务经验，提供可靠的汽车保险。通过 ChatGPT 使用 Liberty Mutual，只需提供几项简单信息，就能快速获得个性化汽车保险报价估算。

获取估算无需购买。通过 ChatGPT 与我们对话时，您在聊天中提供的个人信息受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策约束，并可能与 Liberty Mutual、其关联公司及服务提供商共享，用于为您提供汽车保险报价估算。请仅提供 Liberty Mutual 为生成报价估算而提出的问题所要求的个人信息。请勿提供额外的敏感个人信息。要了解 Liberty Mutual 如何处理您的个人信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策。

payload.name: Kick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use MCP to connect ChatGPT to Kick to automate your accounting across your businesses and clients. Analyze your financial statements, categorize transactions, post journal entries, and close your books faster. ChatGPT drafts, you review and approve with confidence.
payload.longDescription: 使用 MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Kick，自动处理旗下企业和客户的会计事务。分析财务报表、分类交易、过账日记账分录，并更快完成结账。ChatGPT 起草，由你审阅并放心批准。

payload.name: RetirementIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a fast, clear snapshot of how prepared you are for retirement—based on your age, income, and current savings. See an easy retirement “score,” an on-track status, and the key numbers to focus on next. Free to use right now for a limited time.
payload.longDescription: 根据年龄、收入和当前储蓄，快速清晰地了解你的退休准备程度。查看易于理解的退休“评分”、是否按计划推进的状态，以及接下来应关注的关键数字。目前限时免费使用。

payload.name: Buy Or Rent Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
payload.longDescription:
通过全面的买房与租房模拟器，作出充分知情的房地产决策。此应用提供客观、数据驱动的分析，判断购买房产是否确实比租房并将资金投向其他用途更划算。

模拟器结合你所在国家的 IMF 历史及预测通胀数据，逐年跟踪资金的实际价值。从首次偿还房贷到最终转售，它提供完整的财务分解，让你依据自身具体项目保持客观判断。

主要功能：
- 使用各国 IMF 通胀数据，进行贴近实际的长期预测
- 比较买房成本与其他投资（股市、储蓄等）的潜在回报
- 无需账户或注册，即可立即开始模拟
- 切换高级参数并查看完整摊还表，了解每笔房贷还款

可调整参数：
- 房产：购入价格、公证费、装修成本及中介费
- 融资：首付、贷款期限、房贷利率、保险及提前还款罚金
- 租赁：月租金及预计年度租金涨幅
- 市场逻辑：转售时间、各国通胀率（IMF）及其他投资收益率
- 成本：当地房产税及维护费用

获取清晰、直观的盈亏平衡点报告，准确了解何时持有房产开始带来收益。
